prompt: A barely noticeable push-in on the glass case. The white house falls from the limp, open prongs, hits the slope of the pile roof-first and rolls down among the blue, yellow and green houses before stopping near the front, tilted. A rolled banknote slides off after it. The empty claw dangles, its prongs drooping, then the gantry carries it back along the rail to the top-left corner and it stops there. Lights around the cabinet keep their glow. Sound: a hollow thud and clatter, coins chinking, the gantry motor buzzing back and a final click.
